contexts.text: In the internal sense, it is not quickly, but what is certain.
Therefore the Spirits of Mercury are prompter and quicker in seeing, thinking, and speaking.
He threw off his garment so quickly, that scarcely anything could be done more quickly.
He arrives more quickly when he longs...
Must shortly be done () = not quickly, but certainly, Explained.
I will come unto thee quickly (): quickly = what is certain.
Behold, I come quickly () = the Lord's Advent, and a New Church then from these.
The third woe cometh quickly ()... To come quickly = after this. Explained.
To show unto His servants the things which must shortly be done () = that the Lord has revealed to those in truths from Him the things which will certainly be.
Behold, I come quickly () = that the Lord will certainly come. AR 949.
The time is at hand. By quickly, and at hand, is meant quickly, and nearly, in relation to state.
For the idea of interior persuasion is attended with this: that it is done quickly... and therefore David subjugated many quickly.
Quickly = what is certain and full. References, Explained. AE 106. AE 144. AE 216.
To come quickly = certainly at hand and coming to pass.
